verse.verse_3: you (Prophet Muhammad) are truly among the Messengers sent
verse.verse_5: The sending down of the Mighty, the Most Merciful
verse.verse_6: so that you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, and so were heedless.
verse.verse_7: The Phrase has become obligatory upon most of them, yet they do not believe.
verse.verse_8: We have bound their necks with fetters up to their chin, so that their heads are raised and cannot be lowered.
verse.verse_9: We have set a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and, We have covered them so that they do not see.
verse.verse_10: It is the same whether you have warned them or you have not warned them, they do not believe.
verse.verse_11: You only warn he who follows the Remembrance and fears the Merciful in the Unseen. Give to him glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous wage.
verse.verse_12: Surely, it is We who revive the dead and write down what they have forwarded and what they have left behind; We have counted everything in a Clear Book.
verse.verse_13: Give to them a parable; to the people of the village there came Messengers,
verse.verse_14: We sent to them two, but they belied them so We reinforced them with a third. They said: 'We have surely been sent as Messengers to you'
verse.verse_15: But they said: 'You are only humans like ourselves. The Merciful has not sent down anything, your speech is but lies'
verse.verse_16: They said: 'Our Lord knows that we are Messengers to you.
verse.verse_17: And it is only for us to deliver a Clear Message'
verse.verse_18: They answered: 'We predict evil of you. If you do not desist, we will stone you and a painful punishment from us will befall you'
verse.verse_19: They said: 'Your prediction is with you, if you are reminded. Surely, you are but a wayward nation'
verse.verse_20: Then, a man came running from the furthest part of the village 'My nation' he said, 'follow the Messengers,
verse.verse_21: follow those who ask no wage of you and are rightly guided.
verse.verse_22: Why should I not worship Him who has originated me and to whom you shall all be returned?
verse.verse_23: What, shall I take, other than Him, gods whose intercession, if the Merciful desires to afflict me, cannot help me at all, and they will never save me?
verse.verse_24: Surely, I should then be in clear error.
verse.verse_25: I believe in your Lord, so hear me'
verse.verse_26: It was said (to him): 'Enter Paradise' and he said: 'Would that my people knew
verse.verse_27: that my Lord has forgiven me, and caused me to be amongst the receivers of generosity'
verse.verse_28: And We did not send down to his nation after him any army from heaven, neither would We send any down.
verse.verse_29: It was only one Shout and they were silent, still.
verse.verse_30: Woe, for those (unbelieving) worshipers! They mocked every Messenger that came to them.
verse.verse_31: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them? They shall never return to them,
verse.verse_32: all shall be arraigned before Us.
verse.verse_33: The dead land is a sign for them. We revive it, and from it produce grain from which they eat.
verse.verse_34: And there We made gardens of palms and vines, and in it We caused fountains to gush forth,
verse.verse_35: so that they might eat of its fruit and the labor of their hands. Will they not give thanks?
verse.verse_36: Exaltations to Him who created pairs of all the things the earth produces and of themselves, and that of which they have no knowledge.
verse.verse_37: A sign for them is the night. From it We withdraw the day and they are in darkness.
verse.verse_38: The sun runs to its fixed restingplace; that is the decree of the Almighty, the Knower.
verse.verse_39: And the moon, We have determined it in phases till it returns like an old palmbranch.
verse.verse_40: The sun shall not outstrip the moon, nor shall the night outstrip the day. Each is floating in an orbit.
verse.verse_41: And a sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden Ark (of Noah).
verse.verse_42: And We have created for them the like of it in which they board.
verse.verse_43: We drown them if We will, then they have none to cry to, nor can they be saved,
verse.verse_44: except through Our Mercy and as enjoyment for awhile.
verse.verse_45: When it is said to them: 'Have fear of that which is before you and behind you in order that you find mercy'
verse.verse_46: Yet there never comes to them any sign of their Lord's signs, but they turn away from it.
verse.verse_47: And when it is said to them: 'Spend of that which Allah has given you' the unbelievers say to the believers: 'Are we to feed those whom Allah can feed if He chooses? Surely, you are only in clear error'
verse.verse_48: They also say: 'When will this promise be, if what you say is true'
verse.verse_49: They await but one Shout, which will seize them while they dispute.
verse.verse_50: Then they will be unable to make a will, nor shall they return to their kinsmen.
verse.verse_51: And the Horn is blown, and, from the graves they rush forth to their Lord.
verse.verse_52: 'Woe for us' they will say. 'Who has roused us from our sleepingplace? This is what the Merciful promised; the Messengers have spoken the truth'
verse.verse_53: And it is but one Shout and they are all arraigned before Us.
verse.verse_54: Today, no soul shall be wronged a thing. You shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.
verse.verse_55: Indeed, the companions of the Garden are this Day busy in their rejoicing.
verse.verse_56: Together with their spouses, they shall recline on couches in the shade.
verse.verse_57: They shall have fruits and all that they call for.
verse.verse_58: Peace, a saying from the Most Merciful Lord.
verse.verse_59: (And He will say): 'Distance yourselves, O sinners, this Day.
verse.verse_60: Children of Adam, did I not make a covenant with you, that you should not worship satan he is surely a clear enemy to you
verse.verse_61: and that you worship Me? Surely, that is the Straight Path.
verse.verse_62: Yet he has led many a host of you astray, did you not understand?
verse.verse_63: This, then is Gehenna (Hell), that which you were promised.
verse.verse_64: Roast well therein this Day for you were unbelievers'
verse.verse_65: This Day We set a seal on their mouths and their hands speak to Us, and their feet will testify to their earnings.
verse.verse_66: Had it been Our will We would have obliterated their sight so that they raced to the Path. But, how would they see?
verse.verse_67: Had it been Our will We would have transmuted them (into monkeys, pigs and stones) where they were, so that they could neither go forward nor yet return.
verse.verse_68: To whoever We give a long life We make him stoop. Do they not understand?
verse.verse_69: We have not taught him (Prophet Muhammad) poetry, nor does it become him. This is only a Remembrance and a Clear Holy Reading (Koran)
verse.verse_70: that he may warn the living, and so that Judgement may be passed against the unbelievers.
verse.verse_71: Have they not seen how We have created for them the cattle they master with Our Hands?
verse.verse_72: We have subdued these to them, and some of them they ride and some of them they eat;
verse.verse_73: they also have other uses in them and drinks. What, will they not give thanks!
verse.verse_74: And yet they have taken gods, other than Allah, so that they might helped!
verse.verse_75: They cannot help them, for them (the socalled) army are brought (with them to Hell).
verse.verse_76: So do not let their sayings grieve you. Surely, We have knowledge of what they hide and all that they reveal.
verse.verse_77: Has the human not seen how We created him from a drop (of sperm)? Yet he is a clear opponent.
verse.verse_78: And he has struck for Us a parable, and forgotten his own creation. He asks: 'Who will quicken the bones after they have decayed'
verse.verse_79: Say: 'He will quicken them who originated them the first time; He has knowledge of every creation;
verse.verse_80: who has made fire for you from the green tree with which you kindle'
verse.verse_81: Is He who created the heavens and the earth unable to create their like? Yes, indeed, He is the Creator, the Knower.
verse.verse_82: When He wills a thing, His command is to say to it 'Be', and it is!
verse.verse_83: Exaltations to Him in whose Hand is the Kingdom of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
